findings.reason: without a followup naming §52 the plan's dispatch chain has no next step, which is the same defect an earlier review raised for §51 and the author fixed by adding this very followup.
findings.text: §52 is the plan's only new implementable section, yet every followup is resolved except `f-wns-006`, which recommends `Build §51` for a section this same change marks `done`; a coordinator following the plan's own chain therefore rebuilds §51 and never dispatches §52

findings.reason: a one-line heading prefix makes the section addressable as `§52` the way the plan and its briefs refer to sections.
findings.text: §52's heading reads `A launch whose holder is alive is never released as stranded` with no section number, while §51 and the sections before §49 read `§NN — …` and every followup and dispatch addresses a section as `§NN`, so the next node to build this one cannot find it by the name the chain uses

findings.reason: the conclusion the counts support, that nearly every release deleted a review, still holds at 47 of 50, and the repair does not depend on the split.
findings.text: the Why says `68 were review runs: 50 on 11 November and 16 by 03:15Z on 12 November`, but the trace directory holds 74 `launch-span-exceeded` releases by 03:15Z of which 69 are review runs; 11 November holds 50 releases of which 47 are review runs, and 12 November to 03:15Z holds 16 of which 15 are review, so 50 and 16 are release counts presented as review counts and the total is one short

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §52's heading carries no `§52 —` number while every numbered section and the followup convention address sections as `§NN`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §52 names three arms and a negative control at the base revision that releases the live-holder launch and fails the first assertion, so the gate can show the guard fires.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate is a test on a temporary crew home with matched arms on the `all_debug` partition, and the section's write paths name the node's fragment; no scratchpad path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §52 introduces no plan label, ticket number or version tag, and its prose names mechanisms rather than a tracker entry.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the root cause matches the code and the release traces, but the review-run counts in the Why mislabel release counts as review counts.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §52's deliverable is one outcome, a live holder's launch is not released; the trace's reviewed-run id is the same release path's record of what it did, not a second investigation.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `s52` is declared `implementable` but no followup names it, and the only open followup (`f-wns-006`, plan.html:363) names §51, which this change marks `done`.
